entries.title: Crewmates' git no longer takes a little system memory with every call
entries.body: On macOS 26, each git command a crewmate's tools ran kept about 1 KB of system memory until the Mac restarted. The app's git now starts in a way that keeps none, and it starts a little faster too.
entries.noPicture: The change is in how the app's git starts; no view or control changes.
